verdict.rationale: The only in-product AI evidence is a marketing line saying you can describe what you want in plain text and Bento's AI will build it (bento-docs-10). That is AI generation from a prompt, not insights drawn from your data. The MCP server lets an external AI assistant query subscribers and events (bento-docs-5, bento-docs-17), but that analysis happens outside the product. missing for 10: documented in-product AI insights or recommendations based on subscriber, event or revenue data, detail on what the built-in AI actually analyzes or suggests, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
